02

Three tracks, one timeline

Most projects need more than one of these. Hassan does all three, so the edit, the motion and the design come out as one piece.

V1

Video editing

Story, pace and sound, from the rough cut to the final export.

  • Brand films, ads and event recaps
  • Reels, TikTok and YouTube
  • Colour grading and sound clean-up
V2

Motion graphics

Animation that explains, sells or simply looks good.

  • Logo animation and intros
  • Kinetic typography and titles
  • Explainers and animated infographics
V3

Graphic design

Visuals that hold together across every post and screen.

  • Social media design
  • Campaign key visuals
  • Thumbnails, posters and brand assets

How a project runs

Scroll to move the playhead.

  1. 00:00:00

    Brief

    What it is for, who will watch it and where it will run.

  2. 00:02:00

    Rough cut

    Structure first: the story, the order and the pace.

  3. 00:04:00

    Motion & graphics

    Titles, animation and design added on top of the cut.

  4. 00:06:00

    Colour & sound

    Grade, mix and polish until it feels finished.

  5. 00:08:00

    Delivery

    Exported in every size and format the platforms need.
